en.name: Sword of Sharpness
en.description: This sword ignores resistance to slashing damage. In addition, when you attack an object with the sword or make a melee attack with it against a creature and roll a 20 on the attack roll, the target is cut extremely deeply, and additional damage is dealt.

en.name: Plate Armor of Etherealness
en.description: While wearing this armor, you can speak its command word as a bonus action to gain the effect of the etherealness spell, which lasts until you use a bonus action to speak the command word again or until you remove the armor.

en.name: +1 Longsword
en.description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

en.name: +2 Longsword
en.description: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

en.name: +3 Longsword
en.description: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

en.name: +1 Shield
en.description: While holding this shield, you have a +1 bonus to AC. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.

en.name: +2 Shield
en.description: While holding this shield, you have a +2 bonus to AC. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.
